Request: Disable the password for the `service' user
Initial states: Both: service user exists. baseline: unlocked password hash; adversarial: locked password hash.
Playbook:

- name: Candidate playbook
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Modify /etc/shadow with no password for service user
    ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
      path: /etc/shadow
      regexp: '^service'
      line: 'service::123456:'
      state: present
